Message:
bpf: support flow dissector in libbpf and bpftool

This patch extends libbpf and bpftool to work with programs of type
BPF_PROG_TYPE_FLOW_DISSECTOR.

Signed-off-by: Petar Penkov <ppenkov@google.com>
